features: Smart analysis with smart IPC: target count, object left/lost, area detection, line crossing

Network protocols: UPnP, SNMP, NTP, SADP, SMTP, NFS, iSCSI, PPPoE, DHCP
Remote monitoring via AEeye app (iPhone, iPad, Android) and Windows/Mac client
